changeSet.author: mini-core
changeSet.sql: CREATE SEQUENCE minicore.transactions_transaction_id_seq START WITH 100000

changeSet.author: mini-core
changeSet.comment: Design note: balances are stored as columns directly on the accounts table for simplicity. A more flexible alternative would be a separate account_balances table with (account_id, balance_name) rows referencing the balances domain table — that would allow adding new balance types (e.g. LEDGER, HOLD) without schema changes. We chose the simpler approach because this is a teaching tool and two hardcoded columns are easier to query and explain.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE minicore.accounts ( account_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT nextval('minicore.accounts_account_id_seq'), account_number VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL UNIQUE, product_type minicore.product_type_enum NOT NULL, status minicore.account_status_enum NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE', -- See changeset comment above for why these are columns instead of a separate table available_balance NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00, collected_balance NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00, currency_code VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD', created_by VARCHAR(20), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() )

changeSet.author: mini-core
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE minicore.transactions ( transaction_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT nextval('minicore.transactions_transaction_id_seq'), account_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES minicore.accounts(account_id), original_transaction_id BIGINT UNIQUE REFERENCES minicore.transactions(transaction_id), transaction_code NUMERIC(5) NOT NULL, amount NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL, direction minicore.transaction_direction_enum NOT NULL, status minicore.transaction_status_enum NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', json_payload JSONB, effective_date DATE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE, created_by VARCHAR(20), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), CONSTRAINT chk_amount_positive CHECK (amount > 0), CONSTRAINT chk_transaction_lifecycle CHECK ( (original_transaction_id IS NULL AND status IN ('PENDING', 'POSTED')) OR (original_transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('POSTED', 'CANCELLED')) ) )

changeSet.author: mini-core
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE minicore.transaction_balances ( transaction_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES minicore.transactions(transaction_id), account_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES minicore.accounts(account_id), available_balance NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL, collected_balance NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() )

changeSet.author: mini-core
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE minicore.outbox_accounts ( event_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, operation_type minicore.operation_type_enum NOT NULL, snapshot_type VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL CHECK (snapshot_type IN ('PRE', 'POS')), account_id BIGINT NOT NULL, account_number VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, product_type minicore.product_type_enum NOT NULL, status minicore.account_status_enum NOT NULL, available_balance NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL, collected_balance NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL, currency_code VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, created_by VARCHAR(20), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, processed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, event_created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() )

changeSet.author: mini-core
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE minicore.outbox_transactions ( event_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, operation_type minicore.operation_type_enum NOT NULL, transaction_id BIGINT NOT NULL, account_id BIGINT NOT NULL, original_transaction_id BIGINT, transaction_code NUMERIC(5) NOT NULL, amount NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL, direction minicore.transaction_direction_enum NOT NULL, status minicore.transaction_status_enum NOT NULL, json_payload JSONB, effective_date DATE NOT NULL, created_by VARCHAR(20), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, processed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, event_created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() )

changeSet.author: mini-core
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE minicore.outbox_accounts_bulk ( bulk_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, first_event_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES minicore.outbox_accounts(event_id), last_event_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES minicore.outbox_accounts(event_id), status minicore.bulk_status_enum NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CREATED', sent_at TIMESTAMPTZ, confirmed_at TIMESTAMPTZ, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), CONSTRAINT chk_accounts_bulk_range CHECK (last_event_id >= first_event_id) )

changeSet.author: mini-core
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE minicore.outbox_transactions_bulk ( bulk_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, first_event_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES minicore.outbox_transactions(event_id), last_event_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES minicore.outbox_transactions(event_id), status minicore.bulk_status_enum NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CREATED', sent_at TIMESTAMPTZ, confirmed_at TIMESTAMPTZ, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), CONSTRAINT chk_transactions_bulk_range CHECK (last_event_id >= first_event_id) )

changeSet.author: mini-core
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE minicore.outbox_accounts_confirmations ( event_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES minicore.outbox_accounts(event_id), dtw_confirmation VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() )

changeSet.author: mini-core
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE minicore.outbox_transactions_confirmations ( event_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES minicore.outbox_transactions(event_id), dtw_confirmation VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() )

changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE minicore.outbox_accounts_sync_wait_confirmation ( event_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES minicore.outbox_accounts(event_id), bulk_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES minicore.outbox_accounts_bulk(bulk_id), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() )

changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE minicore.dtw_transaction_mapping ( local_transaction_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES minicore.transactions(transaction_id), dtw_transaction_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE, sync_status minicore.sync_status_enum NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() )

changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE minicore.sync_cursors ( cursor_name VARCHAR(100) PRIMARY KEY, last_processed_event_id BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() )
